article.p: We use cookies to enhance your website experience and help us identify any issues and areas for improvement. You can either "accept all" cookies or "manage preferences" to control the use of cookies. If you choose not to accept some cookies, please note you may experience a more limited functionality on our website. You can change your cookie preferences at any time.

div.p: A cookie is a small file containing just text, downloaded on to a device when a user accesses certain web sites. Cookies are useful because they allow a web site to recognise a user's device. Cookies allow us to store information related to your website visit which enables you to be shown relevant content to you while you’re browsing.

Cookies can also help us identify issues and improve the website, enhancing the experience for all users. We cannot identify individual users from these cookies. As well as the functionality below, you may be able to block the use of Cookies through your browser, please refer to our cookies policy for further information.

These are cookies that are required for the operation of our website. They include, for example, cookies that enable you to log into secure areas of our website, use our designer tools and save preferences for plots. It is not currently possible to turn these cookies off.

These allow us to recognise and count the number of visitors and to see how visitors move around our website when they are using it. This helps us to improve the way our website works, for example, by ensuring that users are finding what they are looking for easily. It is not possible to gain any personal information from these cookies. You can also opt-out of having your site activity available to Google Analytics by installing the Google Analytics opt-out browser add-on, for further information and guidance, please read the article here: https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/181881?hl=en&ref_topic=2919631

These are used to recognise you when you return to our website. This enables us to personalise our content for you, greet you by name, favourite plots and remember your preferences. It is not currently possible to turn these cookies off.

These cookies record your visit to our website, the pages you have visited and the links you have followed. We will use this information to make our website and the advertising displayed on it more relevant to your interests. We may also share this information with third parties for this purpose, and details of the third parties can be accessed through our Cookie Policy: https://www.storyhomes.co.uk/cookies-privacy/.

div.div: Buying a Story house has been a very positive experience. Fiona was exceptional in giving us any information we required and went above and beyond in customer care. It has been a pleasure and we are looking forward to moving to Summerpark and being near our family who have also purchased Story homes. Louise Gordon
Had a great experience so far with going through buying a new build home from Fiona Ure @ Story Homes.
Fiona was very welcoming when we entered the show home. Expert knowledge
Deborah made the whole experience a delight. She thought of everything we needed and sorted it all out. We are delighted with our new home and would recommend your company to anyone.

Over multiple visits to view the show home, Fiona at Story Dumfries made sure we had all the information wr needed to help with our decision. She was able to answer any questions we had and always returned email queries quickly.

Zara made the process of putting our reservation down so easy, she explained everything to us clearly about our next steps and what we needed to do! She was able to answer all of our questions and made us feel at ease about the whole process

Had a meeting with Wendy at the Foxbridge Rise site today and she was fab! Explained everything we needed to know and was more than happy to answer any of my random questions. Can’t fault the service so far ️

Sam has been amazing with providing us with information about the property we are buying and also the site as a whole. She keeps in contact regularly and is always more than happy to answer any questions we have in timely manner. She has been amazing in helping us secure the plot we wanted. I couldn’t fault the service so far that has been provided. It’s always a pleasure to go and speak to the staff in the Story Homes marketing suite.

We are in the process of buying our new home and everything has been such a smooth process from early birding our home back in February 2025 to selecting our upgrades and choices. Wendy at Foxbridge Rise has been fantastic and a consistent point of contact. She has answered all of our queries with no hesitation and has been so helpful. We are very much looking forward to moving into our new home early next year!
Quick response from Michael with the information we needed. I have contacted Storyhomes in the past and always get a quick and helpful response.
